auth.termsBody:
Welcome to VIVID (the "Service"), which provides AI-generated e-commerce images, videos and related editing capabilities.
Please read these Terms carefully before registering or using the Service. By registering, signing in, or using the Service in any way, you agree to all terms herein.
You warrant that the email and other information submitted at registration are true and valid, and that you will keep your account and password safe. Losses caused by improper account keeping are borne by you.
Materials you upload must be lawfully owned by you or properly authorized, and must not infringe others' intellectual property or portrait rights, nor violate any laws. You are responsible for the compliant use of generated results.
Do not use the Service for any illegal activity. We may restrict or terminate accounts that violate these terms when necessary.
These Terms may be updated as the Service evolves; updates will be posted on this page. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
auth.privacyBody:
VIVID values your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information.
Information we collect includes your registration email, product images and text materials you upload, and configuration parameters required for generation tasks. In this demo, such data is stored only locally in your browser.
Your information is used solely to create and identify your account, complete AI generation tasks, provide generation history, and improve service quality. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information security against leakage, loss or misuse.
You may access, correct or delete your account information, and may sign out or clear local data at any time.
If this policy changes, we will update it on this page. For questions, reach us through the contact provided in the product.
